normal">1036 – X – 0200 – GA – Rev E (Supersedes dwg. 1036 - 0200 - GA C)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:

1036 - 0201 - GA B)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">1036 – X – 0202 – GA – Rev C (Supersedes dwg. 1036 - 0202 - GA B)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:

normal">1036 – X – 0400 – GA – Rev E (Supersedes dwg. 1036 - 0400 - GA D)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">1036 – X – 0401 – GA – Rev D (Supersedes dwg. 1036 - 0401 - GA C)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Outline Construction Logistic Plan, Paul Mews Associates dated July
2022<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Servicing Statement, Paul Mews Associates dated July 2022<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>







































</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved
plans except where conditions attached to this planning permission indicate
otherwise or where alternative details have been subsequently approved
following an application for a non-material amendment.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior to the commencement of development, full details of all new walls
and enclosures including those relating to balconies and terraces, shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and the
development shall be constructed in accordance with approved details and
thereafter retained such for the lifetime of the development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Notwithstanding any indications shown on the submitted plans, prior to
the commencement of development, further scale 1:50 drawings (including cross-section
plans) showing additional design detailing on the east facing balcony facades which shall be submitted
to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plans shall include
design details and materials to be used to on the elevations to ensure sufficient daylight is provided to the associated
residential units, and the amenity of the adjacent southern properties is
protected from overlooking and loss of privacy by providing only skyline
outlook. The development shall be constructed in accordance with approved
details and thereafter retained such for the lifetime of the development.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior commencement of development a detailed Construction Logistic Plan
must be submitted to and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Construction
and Logistics Plan and Delivery<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">and Servicing Plan must be submitted using the TfL template and
guidance found in<o:p></o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><a href="https://www.walthamforest.gov.uk/parking-roads-and-travel/roads-and-pavements/highways-advicedevelopers/">https://www.walthamforest.gov.uk/parking-roads-and-travel/roads-and-pavements/highways-advicedevelopers/</a>
construction-logistics and shall include details of site access, journey
planning, access routes, hours of deliveries, temporary traffic arrangements or
restrictions, site operation times, loading and unloading locations and storage
of building materials. All works shall be carried out in accordance with the
approved details and the Construction and Logistics Plan should be implemented
throughout the construction works.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior to the commencement of development a Waste and Refuse Management
Strategy incorporating full details of the levels and type of provision and location to store
collect refuse and recyclable materials, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority. The strategy must also include the design and construction of refuse stores and the
means of access for collection by refuse operatives and vehicles. The
development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and
the refuse/recycling stores brought into use prior to the occupation of the
development hereby permitted.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior to the first occupation of the new residential units, a detailed
Site Safety and Security Strategy for the site and future occupiers including details of windows and door
sets, boundary treatment, lighting and CCTV system, entry control system shall
be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and
the agreed proposal shall be installed and fully operational prior to first
occupation, and thereafter shall be fully retained and maintained as such for
the lifetime of the development.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior to the first occupation of the new residential units, a lighting
scheme shall be submitted to and<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, which shall
incorporate measures to ensure that light from the luminaires would not exceed
10 EV(lux) when measured at any residential or light sensitive window
overlooking the development, all luminaries shall be oriented and designed in
such a way to minimise light spillage beyond the site boundary and prevent
glare to the windows of residential or light sensitive properties identified,
and this lighting scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the agreed
details prior to first occupation, and thereafter maintained as such for the
lifetime of the development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior to the first occupation of the new residential units, details
relating to the residential entrances<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">including gates, entry control system, display of postal numbers and
position of letter box facility shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by
the Local Planning Authority, and the agreed proposal shall be fully implemented
prior to first occupation and thereafter maintained for the lifetime of the
development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior to the first occupation of new residential development the cycle
storage as shown in drawing<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">number 1036 - 0200 - GA E shall be provided as for future residential
occupiers and shall thereafter be maintained for the lifetime of the
development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">During the development works, sound insulation shall be installed
between the commercial premises and residential premises (within and outside of the development site)
in order manage noise and disturbance. The scheme of noise insulation measures shall be prepared
by a suitably qualified consultant/engineer and shall acheive sound insulation level of
protection which is at least +10dB above the Approved Document E standard (Dwelling
houses and flats) for airborne sound insulation and -10dB for impact sound
insulation. These levels shall thereafter be maintained as such for the
lifetime of the development.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Within the residential unit(s) hereby approved the following internal
noise levels shall be achieved and not exceeded with the windows closed: 35dB(A) Leq 16 hours 07:00hrs
– 23:00hrs in living rooms, while 30dB(A) Leq 8 hours in bedrooms and no individual noise event to
exceed 45dB(A) max (measured with F time weighting) 23:00hrs – 07:00hrs. These levels
shall thereafter be maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior to the commencement of development hereby approved, details of the
specific measures to be adopted to achieve at least a 35% reduction in carbon
emissions over the 2013 Building Regulations together with details of the
renewable sources of energy to be incorporated within the development, shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved details and
the energy statement submitted, relating to achieving carbon emissions
reduction. Any subsequent shortfall shall be compensated by payment to the
Council's Carbon Offset Fund. The approved measures shall be incorporated into
the development, and thereafter maintained in accordance with the approved
details for the lifetime of the development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Prior to the first occupation of residential units hereby permitted,
details setting out how measures of water use within the development shall meet a target water
use of 105 litres or less per person, per day will be acheived, shall be submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority, and the development shall be constructed in accordance with
the approved scheme and thereafter retained as such for the lifetime of the development.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">No development shall take place whatsoever, until a Demolition and
Construction Method Statement including any demolition works, has been submitted to, and approved in
writing by, the local planning authority. The approved Statement shall be adhered to throughout the
demolition and construction period. The Statement shall provide for the:</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">• parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">• loading and unloading of plant and materials<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">• storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">• erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative
displays and facilities for public<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">viewing, with appropriate<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">• wheel washing facilities • measures to control emissions, dust and
dirt during construction<o:p></o:p></p><p>



















</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">• recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and
construction works<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">No non-road mobile machinery (NRMM) shall be used on the site unless it
is compliant with the NRMM Low Emission Zone requirements (or any superseding requirements)
and until it has been registered for use on the site on the NRMM register (or any superseding
register).</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Either: </p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><br></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the materials details approved under discharge of condition LPA reference 230512 as shown in approved documents:</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><br></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 14px;">- Cover Letter from pH+ ref. 1036 dated 23/02/2023</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 14px;">-Location Plan Dwg. No. 0000 Rev. T3</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><span style="font-size: 14px;">

</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">

</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 14px;">- Condition Discharge Report by pH+1036 April 2023</span><b><o:p></o:p></b></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Or:</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><br></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal">Notwithstanding condition 2, Prior to the commencement of development
full schedule of materials (including colours, textures along with manufacturing specification
were necessary ) to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby
approved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development
shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter
retained as such for the lifetime of the development.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><o:p></o:p></p>
description:
Variation of Condition 2 (Plans) via a Section
73 planning permission reference 214014, granted 17/01/2023.
Proposed alterations to the ground floor layout affecting location of refuse,
cycling stores and plant room, Minor alterations to layouts and circulation
area of flats, alterations to external finish of building.
